versions.changelog:
Initial public release of the idea-to-post skill.

- Expands scattered ideas into high-quality social media posts (90+ point standard)
- Guides users through 7–10 rounds of progressive questioning (direction, deep dive, case studies, emotions, uniqueness)
- Integrates automatic web searching to enrich ideas with background, data, and examples
- Internalizes thinking frameworks for natural, guided questions (no jargon exposed)
- Outputs content tailored for multiple social media platforms with structured formatting
- Includes iterative polishing and optimization after content generation
